# noses — Osmograph Vial authoring CLI

> Author, validate, test and publish Osmograph Vials. One format: `vial.json`
> (`osmograph.domain-pack/1`) plus optional sandboxed HTML fragments beside it.
> Target time-to-first Vial: under a minute, no hardware.

## Commands
- `noses new <Name> [--publisher <handle>] [--domain <domain>]` — scaffold a Vial offline.
  The scaffold fails the gate on purpose (empty citations, `REPLACE ME` markers).
- `noses lint [path]` / `noses validate [path]` — the policy gate, locally.
- `noses test [path]` — lint + which bridge calls the UI declares. Static only.
- `noses publish [path] --repo <github-url> [--branch main] [--evidence A|B|C]` — print
  `sha256(vial.json)` and the registry entry. It does not sign or upload.

## Rules an agent must satisfy
- `schema` is exactly `osmograph.domain-pack/1`; `id` is lowercase `publisher.slug`.
- `whatItIsNot` (30+ chars) must name the claim the Vial refuses, with an explicit negation.
- At least one real citation, at least two `docs` sections.
- Widgets: `hero`, `risk` (with `always` and `never`), `docs`, `rig`, and one of
  `tracking`, `diagram`, `rules`.
- High/critical risk: at least one `rules` entry with `severity: "stop"` and three `docs`.
- No unnegated overclaims: safe to eat, pathogen test/detection, diagnosis, ethylene
  detection, absolute concentration/ppm, cross-rig, works on any rig/array/device,
  guarantee, medical diagnosis/device/advice, gas leak detector/certified safety device.
- No executable content in the manifest. UI code belongs in `ui.html` / `home.html`.
- A UI is a body fragment (no `doctype`/`html`/`head`/`body`/`base`), no remote assets,
  no `fetch`/`XMLHttpRequest`/`WebSocket`, no `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`/`indexedDB`,
  no `eval`/`new Function`, no `javascript:` URLs.
- Only these bridge methods exist: `version`, `onData`, `action`, `ready`, `toast`,
  `setDetection`, `setTransforms`, `setTrajectory`.

## Host contract (what a Vial may rely on)
- Payload: `{ schema, snapshot, series, sources, selectedSource, events, domain, view, host }`.
- `snapshot.channelLimits[ch] = { dead, cv, min, max, r0 }` — measured, host-owned.
- `snapshot.detectionConfig`, `snapshot.detection = { active, triggeredChannels }`,
  `snapshot.baseline = { state, progress, ageSec }`, `snapshot.anomaly`, `snapshot.trajectory`.
- Transforms: baseline `first-n` · `session-mean`; response `delta-over-r0` · `relative` ·
  `delta`; conditioning `median3`. Unsupported requests are refused by the host.
- Single-unit limits only. `4 × measured cv` is the suggested starting point, not a claim.
- Dead channels are excluded; a Vial may tighten a limit but never bypass a refusal.
